message:
Compute gross-of-costs returns from each session's own costs (REVIEW-19) (#26)

* Compute gross-of-costs returns from each session's own costs (REVIEW-19)

Gross returns divided each session's P&L by equity plus every cost paid so
far, so the gross CAGR, Sharpe and drawdown, the cost drag, the quantile
table's gross and cost-drag columns and the "before costs" equity line all
understated costs as they accumulated (BH-2026-10-15-1). A session's gross
return is now its net return plus that session's trading and borrow costs
over the previous close's equity, compounded from the initial capital, so
the cost drag equals the costs paid per year as a fraction of equity.

Also record the open medium bug-hunt findings BH-2026-10-09-1, -2 and
BH-2026-10-15-2 as REVIEW-20 and REVIEW-21, and refresh the docs that
quote gross figures.

* Sum each session's cost columns for gross returns; note corrected gross figures (REVIEW-19)

Round 3 review follow-ups: read per-session costs from the cost columns rather
than differencing the running total, drop a test assertion the old code also
met, point the historical results table to the corrected gross figures, and
record the quantile part of BH-2026-10-09-2 in REVIEW-20.
